Name: Jahath, Son of Gershom
Summary: Son of Gershom and father of Shimei in Asaph's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:43: Son of Gershom and father of Shimei in Asaph's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jahath stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
